name: System description
description: Description of the device and its software.

name: Device type identifier
description: Manufacturer's authoritative identification of the device type.

name: Time since network management restart
description: Time since the network management portion of the system was reinitialised.

name: Network interface hardware address
description: Hardware address associated with a network interface.

name: Device description
description: Description of the device, including its manufacturer and revision where available.

name: Printing technology

name: Printer language family

name: Printer language version
description: Version of the language supported by an interpreter.
